name: More Valuable Than Gold
summary: Mason Connery gives you a note after you free him, pointing toward a hidden treasure. He says it may be worth more than gold.

sections.title: A Hidden Cache
sections.body: After you free Mason Connery, he gives you a note and says it can lead to treasure. He has no gold to offer, but asks you to say he died if anyone asks where the note came from. You use it to find a small chest buried in a shallow hole. Inside are documents, maps, and official-looking seals, though most of it makes little sense to you.

sections.title: Strange Papers
sections.body: Among the papers are insignias from Stormwind, Gilneas, Lordaeron, and unfamiliar authorities. A map names a place called Kalidar, while a blurry painting shows what appears to be a female ogre. A partly burned survey report bears the label “A. Crater; Kalimdor.” Still, you suspect the papers may be worth something to someone.

faq.answer: Mason Connery gives you a note meant to help you find his hidden treasure.
You find the treasure chest buried in a shallow hole in the ground.
The chest holds documents, maps, and official-looking seals.

faq.q: Why does Mason say to tell people he died?
faq.answer: Mason asks you to say the person who gave you the note died, vaporized by dragonfire and blown out to sea.
